title: Push Down Method

solutions.title: weeklyPayrollHours(), staff only
solutions.tradeoff: FreelanceTutor loses a method it never called, and any future code that wants payroll hours from a bare Tutor reference now has to narrow to StaffTutor first instead of finding the method waiting on every tutor.

reviewFocus: Does FreelanceTutor ever call weeklyPayrollHours() anywhere in the challenge? If not, the walkthrough's claim that only one subclass uses it should be checkable by grep, not just asserted.
Is weeklyPayrollHours() concrete only on StaffTutor after the move, or does Tutor still declare it in some form?
Did weeklyPayrollReport's filter change from a string check to a type predicate as part of this move, and does the walkthrough explain why that change was forced rather than optional?
Does the walkthrough name the further question - whether staff versus freelance should be a subclass distinction at all - or does it stop at 'moved the method, done'?

Compare against drill-12-01: that drill moves a method up because both subclasses need it the same way. Does this walkthrough's argument for moving down actually use the same test in reverse, or a different one?
